meta.title: Send Bulk Counter Offer is offered on a live RFQ where Vendor An and Vendor B have bid

plan.title: Bulk Counter Offer availability with two bids

steps.note: Open the prepared live RFQ with two bids on its Responses tab.
Open the stage Settings menu where Send Bulk Counter Offer is offered.
Assert the bulk counter-offer action is present and clickable.
Select the enabled action to open its counter-offer window.
Assert the bulk counter-offer window opened and exposes its Cancel control.
Cancel the window without confirming any counter offer.
Assert the counter-offer window closed after cancellation.
